headline.kr: Macy's의 Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년 exclusive Disney Capsule Collection 및 Kohl's의 IP merchandise 확장
headline.en: Macy's Debuts Exclusive Disney Capsule Collection for Parade Centenary & Kohl's Expands IP Merchandise Assortment

summary.kr: Macy's가 Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년을 기념하는 exclusive Disney capsule collection을 런칭했습니다. 동시에 Kohl's는 인기 streaming IP를 활용한 merchandise를 대거 선보이며 연말 Holiday 시즌 준비에 박차를 가하고 있습니다.
summary.en: Macy's has launched an exclusive Disney capsule collection celebrating its Thanksgiving Day Parade centenary. Concurrently, Kohl's is aggressively expanding its holiday merchandise assortment by introducing major streaming IP-inspired collections.

buyerInsights.kr: Netflix의 인기 IP 'KPop Demon Hunters'를 접목한 대규모 merchandise collection을 공개하며 Gen Z 타겟 category 확장에 집중하고 있습니다.
buyerInsights.en: Kohl's is focusing on expanding its Gen Z-targeted categories by dropping a major merchandise collection inspired by Netflix's hit IP 'KPop Demon Hunters'.

buyerInsights.kr: Hollister가 Northern Ireland의 The Boulevard에 두 번째 offline store 오픈을 확정하며 영수요 타겟 retail channel 확장을 지속하고 있습니다.
buyerInsights.en: Hollister has confirmed its second Northern Irish store at The Boulevard, demonstrating continued expansion of its offline retail channels for youth demographics.

buyerInsights.kr: Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년을 맞아 exclusive Disney capsule collection과 holiday merchandise를 전면 배치해 연말 고객 traffic 선점에 나섰습니다.
buyerInsights.en: Macy's is driving year-end customer traffic by rolling out an exclusive Disney capsule collection and holiday merchandise for the Thanksgiving Day Parade centenary.

opportunities.kr: 주요 buyer들의 연말 Holiday 시즌용 IP 콜라보 및 캐릭터 merchandise 기획 물량에 대한 선제적인 reorder 대응 체계를 구축해야 합니다.
opportunities.en: We must establish proactive reorder response systems for major buyers' year-end holiday IP collaboration and character merchandise lines.

opportunities.kr: Kohl's와 Macy's의 엔터테인먼트 및 문화 콘텐츠 IP 결합 상품 확대 추세에 맞춰 신규 디자인 제안의 찬스로 활용해야 합니다.
opportunities.en: We should leverage the increasing trend of entertainment IP-integrated products at Kohl's and Macy's as an opportunity for fresh design proposals.

opportunities.kr: Hollister의 offline store 확장에 발맞추어 매장 내 sell-through가 빠르게 일어나는 core category의 스톡 운영 효율성을 극대화해야 합니다.
opportunities.en: In line with Hollister's offline store expansion, we must maximize stock operation efficiency for core categories showing rapid sell-through.

risk.kr: 주요 유통사들의 Holiday 시즌 merchandise 선제 기획 경쟁이 심화되는 가운데, 환율 변동성(USD/KRW 1,412원대)과 원부자재 시황을 면밀히 모니터링해야 합니다.
risk.en: Amid intensifying competition among major retailers for pre-planned holiday merchandise, we must closely monitor currency volatility (USD/KRW around 1,412) and raw material market conditions.

actions.kr: Macy's 및 Kohl's의 IP 중심 Holiday merchandise sourcing 트렌드 분석 및 당사 대응 제안서 작성
actions.en: Analyze Macy's and Kohl's IP-driven holiday merchandise sourcing trends and prepare our response proposal.

actions.kr: Hollister offline store 오픈 거점별 core category sell-through 데이터 및 재고 현황 점검
actions.en: Review core category sell-through data and inventory status across Hollister's offline store expansion locations.

actions.kr: 환율 변동에 따른 주요 buyers와의 FOB 단가 및 선적 일정 조율 리스크 선제 점검
actions.en: Proactively review FOB pricing and shipping schedule coordination risks with major buyers following currency fluctuations.
